flags: Unverifiable price data — $91.44/bbl cannot be cross-checked against ground truth; WTI has traded well below this level in recent periods, raising fabrication concerns
No timestamp on the quote — critical for trading decisions; 'latest available' is insufficient
Only WTI quoted — Brent crude omitted, which is often equally or more relevant for a PM
